current_date: Version 1.2, last updated January 2024 (footer: 'Planning application requirements February 2023')
current_evidence: This Planning Application Requirements (PAR) v1.2 is the newest general list found. Search also turned up an older 2008/2009 list (amended 2015) and a 2023 PAR. The council's validation guidance page now links only a householder checklist (v1.0, last updated March 2025), so currency is based on the document's version and date, not a page link.

issues.detail: List date 2026-05-01 comes from the upload folder in the URL. The document says Version 1.2, last updated January 2024, with footers reading February 2023.
issues.evidence: Cover: 'Version 1.2 ... last updated January 2024'; footer 'Planning application requirements February 2023'

issues.detail: Grokbot didn't record the separate householder validation checklist that the council's validation guidance page links. It has local requirements, so Householder '(none)' is wrong: existing/proposed elevations, floor plans, roof plans (any roof created or altered), parking and access arrangements (where parking/access affected), tree survey (trees on or adjacent to site), and a DAS for householder works in a conservation area. The PAR also says sections are 'always required for roof space works and ground floor extensions'.

Local requirements in the PAR that Grokbot didn't capture: Accommodation Management Plan (C2/sui generis specialist housing, student housing); Airport Safeguarding Zone Assessment (major development in airport allocation or any app in a public safety zone); Arboricultural Impact Assessment (trees on/adjoining site affected); Archaeological desktop study (known/suspected significance, land adjacent to River Lea); Change of use to C2 children's residential institution statement; Land Contamination Assessment; Lighting Assessment (all major; minor non-householder in conservation areas/near listed buildings/open space); Micro-Climate Assessment (10+ storeys); Noise Impact Assessment; Occupation Statement (annexes); Site Waste Management Plan (all major; new food/drink outlets); Statement of Community Involvement (major); Statement of Need (community facilities E/F1/F2/sui generis); Town Visual Impact Assessment (2+ storeys above prevailing height within 100m or >7 storeys); Works to protected trees replacement scheme.

All 11 tab_items are process or boilerplate text, not requirements: invalid-application 28-day notice, administrative charge for invalid applications from 1 April 2023, file-type advice, data protection and publication consent text, a contact email (developmentcontrol@luton.gov.uk), drawing-titling advice, EIA hard-copy numbers.

Many trigger excerpts are policy reference lists or fragments, not triggers. Examples: Air Quality ('LPP31 – Sustainable Transport Strategy LLP32 – Parking...'; actual trigger: major applications, sensitive uses, or in/near an AQMA); Employment/Economic Statement starts with 'Wildlife Assessment Check'; Transport Assessment and Travel Plan share the same 'Further Guidance can be found...' footer text; Planning Obligations uses viability text; BNG trigger is 'Developers must use the Biodiversity Metric tool'. Flood Risk Assessment omits the real trigger (sites of 1ha+ or Flood Zones 2/3).
issues.evidence: PAR item triggers, e.g. FRA 'Sites of one hectare or more, and new development in Flood Zones 2 or 3'

issues.detail: Most requirements are under Full planning with 'INFERRED' notes. Outline and Reserved matters are '(none)', even though major-application items (Affordable Housing, Air Quality, Energy, Landscaping, SCI, Sustainability) apply to major outline proposals. 'Open space / play space assessment' is under 'Change of use - prior approval', but the PAR trigger is a change of use on designated open space in a planning application, not prior approval. Heritage Statement is put only under Listed building consent, but it also applies to conservation area development, the setting of listed or locally listed buildings, the River Lea, and demolition in conservation areas ('Demolition in cons area' is '(none)').
issues.evidence: Heritage Statement: 'Also required for demolition in conservation areas'

issues.detail: Affordable Housing Statement trigger is cut off mid-sentence ('...on sites of 10 or less new dwellings that ha'). The full trigger is 11+ units, or 10 or fewer with combined floorspace over 1,000 sq m.

summary: The link works and appears to be the current general list (PAR v1.2, January 2024), but Grokbot dated it from the URL upload folder. It missed about 15 local requirements and the separate householder checklist, its tab items are all process text, and many triggers are policy-reference fragments.
